matrix_name.name: thermoplastic polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Electrospun porous TPU fibrous film used as the TPU/CNT substrate.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: CNTs anchored onto TPU fibers by ultrasound with PVP-assisted dispersion to form the TPU/CNT substrate; loading on the substrate not numerically specified.

fillers.name: graphene nanosheets
fillers.description: GN-only filtered conductive layer on the TPU/CNT substrate; conductive-layer area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

matrix_name.name: thermoplastic polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Electrospun porous TPU fibrous film used as the TPU/CNT substrate.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: CNTs anchored onto TPU fibers by ultrasound with PVP-assisted dispersion to form the TPU/CNT substrate; substrate CNT loading not numerically specified.

fillers.name: graphene nanosheets
fillers.description: Graphene component in the filtered GN/CNT conductive layer; total GN/CNT layer area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Additional CNTs in the filtered conductive layer; 10 wt% relative to the GN/CNT conductive layer, whose total area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

matrix_name.name: thermoplastic polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Electrospun porous TPU fibrous film used as the substrate of the double-layer GN/CNT/FeCl3@TPU/CNT film.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: CNTs anchored onto TPU fibers by ultrasound with PVP-assisted dispersion to form the TPU/CNT substrate; substrate CNT loading not numerically specified.

fillers.name: graphene nanosheets
fillers.description: Graphene component in the filtered GN/CNT conductive layer; total GN/CNT layer area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Additional CNTs in the filtered conductive layer; 10 wt% relative to the GN/CNT conductive layer, whose total area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

fillers.name: iron(III) chloride hexahydrate
fillers.description: FeCl3 introduced from a 10 mg/mL GN/CNT/FeCl3 ethanol suspension and diffused into both the GN/CNT layer and TPU fibrous layer; final loading in the composite was not specified.

matrix_name.name: thermoplastic polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Sandwich-structured composite film with two outer TPU/CNT layers and an inner GN/CNT/FeCl3 conductive layer; hot-pressed film used for subsequent characterization.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: CNTs anchored onto both outer TPU fibrous layers by ultrasound with PVP-assisted dispersion; anchored CNT loading not numerically specified.

fillers.name: graphene nanosheets
fillers.description: Graphene component in the inner filtered GN/CNT conductive layer; total GN/CNT layer area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

fillers.name: multi-walled carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Additional CNTs in the inner filtered conductive layer; 10 wt% relative to the GN/CNT conductive layer, whose total area density was 1.87 mg/cm2.

fillers.name: iron(III) chloride hexahydrate
fillers.description: FeCl3 introduced from a 10 mg/mL GN/CNT/FeCl3 suspension and distributed in the inner conductive layer and TPU layers; final loading in the composite was not specified.
